column3: The commandments are treasured with you rather than explicitly within you.
The teaching is singular; its protection is compared with the pupil of the eyes.
The woman is strange or foreign; adultery is not separately specified.
The young man lacks heart, the literal image underlying judgment.
The verb describes striding rather than specifically strolling.
Twilight, evening, the middle of night, and darkness are named without an explicit transition fading into.
Behold introduces the woman, whose heart is described as guarded.
She has made her face firm, and said is expressed as completed.
Peace-offering sacrifices are upon me is a nominal statement, not an explicit completed verb of making offerings.
The man or husband is named without a possessive my.
He has taken the money in his hand and will come home on the full-moon day, without an explicit not until.
The second comparison concerns an anklet or fetter and a fool’s discipline, rather than a deer bounding into a trap.
Ways of Sheol is plural rather than a singular road.
